description: This Java class 'ComponentLoaderConfig' manages the loading and parsing of 'component-load.xml' files for the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve root components and parse component definitions from configuration files, supporting both individual components and component directories.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to load and parse component configuration XML files, including nested class 'ComponentDef' for component definitions.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.ComponentDef
classes.description: Represents a component or component directory with location and type, and includes methods to create instances from XML elements.

methods.name: getRootComponents
methods.description: Returns a list of root directory components defined in the classpath by reading 'component-load.xml'.

methods.name: getComponentsFromConfig
methods.description: Parses a given 'component-load.xml' URL to extract component definitions.

methods.name: parseDocumentFromUrl
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a URL, throwing exception on failure.

methods.name: ComponentDef.of
methods.description: Creates a ComponentDef instance from an XML element, identifying whether it's a single component or a directory.

methods.name: ComponentDef.locationToPath
methods.description: Converts a string location into a Path object, expanding variables.
